description:
Program Overview

The Gates Cambridge Scholarship is one of the world's most international scholarship programs, funding outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree in Computer Science or Artificial Intelligence at the University of Cambridge. The scholarship aims to build a global network of future leaders committed to improving the lives of others.

Funding & Benefits

  • University Composition Fees: Full coverage at the UK rate for entire course duration
  • Maintenance Allowance: £18,744 per year (2026-27 rate) for entire course duration
  • One Economy Return Airfare: Travel to and from UK
  • Academic Development Funding: Up to £2,000 per year for professional development
  • Family Allowance: Up to £10,744 per year for first child (if applicable)
  • Visa Costs: Reimbursement of visa application fees

Eligibility Criteria

  • Nationality: Citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom
  • Academic Excellence: Outstanding academic record (typically first-class honours or equivalent)
  • Leadership Potential: Demonstrated leadership qualities and commitment to improving the lives of others
  • Age Limit: No specific age limit, but typically targets under 30s
  • Course Requirements: Must apply for a full-time postgraduate course at Cambridge (MPhil, PhD, or similar)
  • English Language: Standard Cambridge requirements (IELTS 7.5+ or equivalent)

Application Process

  1. Apply to Cambridge course through Graduate Application Portal
  2. Submit scholarship section with research proposal (1,000-word for PhD; 500-word for Master's)
  3. Gates Cambridge Reference (one additional reference addressing scholarship criteria)
  4. Academic transcripts and CV/Resume
  5. Departmental ranking and shortlisting
  6. Interview panel (February-March 2027)
  7. Final selection (April 2027)

Timeline & Deadlines

StageDate
Application OpensSeptember 2026
US DeadlineOctober 2026
International DeadlineDecember 2026 / January 2027
Interview PeriodFebruary-March 2027
Final NotificationApril 2027

Official Link

https://www.gatescambridge.org

Important Notes

  • Join 1,800+ Gates Cambridge Scholars from 110+ countries.
  • Equal emphasis on academic excellence and social commitment.
  • Frame AI research as addressing global challenges (healthcare, climate change, education).
